name: Zig child process spawning a shell with -c
attack_scenario: user_cmd = "true; rm -rf /" executes the injected tail because sh -c parses it.
negative_test_hint: set user_cmd to "true; rm -rf /" and assert it is passed as a single opaque argv element, never parsed by sh -c

exemplar.explanation: Passing "sh"/"bash" with "-c" makes the third argv element a shell script; any runtime-built value placed there is interpreted with full shell semantics rather than as a single opaque argument.
